inductive TmP : Type
  | lit  : Int -> TmP
  | tvar : Nat -> TmP
  | add  : TmP -> TmP -> TmP
  | mul  : TmP -> TmP -> TmP
  | powp : TmP -> TmP -> TmP

def evalTmP (env : Nat -> Int) : TmP -> Int
  | TmP.lit n    => n
  | TmP.tvar k   => env k
  | TmP.add a b  => evalTmP env a + evalTmP env b
  | TmP.mul a b  => evalTmP env a * evalTmP env b
  | TmP.powp a b => (evalTmP env a) ^ (evalTmP env b).toNat

def evalTmNP (env : Nat -> Nat) : TmP -> Nat
  | TmP.lit n    => n.toNat
  | TmP.tvar k   => env k
  | TmP.add a b  => evalTmNP env a + evalTmNP env b
  | TmP.mul a b  => evalTmNP env a * evalTmNP env b
  | TmP.powp a b => (evalTmNP env a) ^ (evalTmNP env b)

def substTmP (k : Nat) (t : TmP) : TmP -> TmP
  | TmP.lit n    => TmP.lit n
  | TmP.tvar j   => if j = k then t else TmP.tvar j
  | TmP.add a b  => TmP.add (substTmP k t a) (substTmP k t b)
  | TmP.mul a b  => TmP.mul (substTmP k t a) (substTmP k t b)
  | TmP.powp a b => TmP.powp (substTmP k t a) (substTmP k t b)

theorem evalTmP_powp (env : Nat -> Int) (a b : TmP) :
    evalTmP env (TmP.powp a b) = (evalTmP env a) ^ (evalTmP env b).toNat := rfl

theorem evalTmNP_powp (env : Nat -> Nat) (a b : TmP) :
    evalTmNP env (TmP.powp a b) = (evalTmNP env a) ^ (evalTmNP env b) := rfl

theorem substTmP_powp (k : Nat) (t a b : TmP) :
    substTmP k t (TmP.powp a b)
      = TmP.powp (substTmP k t a) (substTmP k t b) := rfl

theorem evalTmP_subst (env : Nat -> Int) (k : Nat) (t : TmP) :
    (a : TmP) ->
      evalTmP env (substTmP k t a) = evalTmP (update env k (evalTmP env t)) a
  | TmP.lit c => rfl
  | TmP.tvar i => by
      by_cases h : i = k
      · simp [substTmP, evalTmP, update, h]
      · simp [substTmP, evalTmP, update, h]
  | TmP.add a b => by
      simp [substTmP, evalTmP, evalTmP_subst env k t a, evalTmP_subst env k t b]
  | TmP.mul a b => by
      simp [substTmP, evalTmP, evalTmP_subst env k t a, evalTmP_subst env k t b]
  | TmP.powp a b => by
      simp [substTmP, evalTmP, evalTmP_subst env k t a, evalTmP_subst env k t b]


theorem evalTmNP_subst (env : Nat -> Nat) (k : Nat) (t : TmP) :
    (a : TmP) ->
      evalTmNP env (substTmP k t a)
        = evalTmNP (updateN env k (evalTmNP env t)) a
  | TmP.lit c => rfl
  | TmP.tvar i => by
      by_cases h : i = k
      · simp [substTmP, evalTmNP, updateN, h]
      · simp [substTmP, evalTmNP, updateN, h]
  | TmP.add a b => by
      simp [substTmP, evalTmNP, evalTmNP_subst env k t a, evalTmNP_subst env k t b]
  | TmP.mul a b => by
      simp [substTmP, evalTmNP, evalTmNP_subst env k t a, evalTmNP_subst env k t b]
  | TmP.powp a b => by
      simp [substTmP, evalTmNP, evalTmNP_subst env k t a, evalTmNP_subst env k t b]

inductive PdP : Type
  | peq  : TmP -> TmP -> PdP
  | ple  : TmP -> TmP -> PdP
  | pand : PdP -> PdP -> PdP
  | pimp : PdP -> PdP -> PdP

def denoteP (env : Nat -> Int) : PdP -> Prop
  | PdP.peq a b  => evalTmP env a = evalTmP env b
  | PdP.ple a b  => evalTmP env a <= evalTmP env b
  | PdP.pand p q => denoteP env p /\ denoteP env q
  | PdP.pimp p q => denoteP env p -> denoteP env q

instance decDenoteP (env : Nat -> Int) : (p : PdP) -> Decidable (denoteP env p)
  | PdP.peq a b => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (evalTmP env a = evalTmP env b))
  | PdP.ple a b => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (evalTmP env a <= evalTmP env b))
  | PdP.pand p q => by
      haveI := decDenoteP env p
      haveI := decDenoteP env q
      exact inferInstanceAs (Decidable (denoteP env p /\ denoteP env q))
  | PdP.pimp p q => by
      haveI := decDenoteP env p
      haveI := decDenoteP env q
      exact inferInstanceAs (Decidable (denoteP env p -> denoteP env q))

def checkP (env : Nat -> Int) (p : PdP) : Bool := decide (denoteP env p)

theorem checkP_sound (env : Nat -> Int) (p : PdP)
    (h : checkP env p = true) : denoteP env p :=
  of_decide_eq_true h

theorem checkP_sound_powp (env : Nat -> Int) (a b : TmP)
    (h : checkP env (PdP.peq (TmP.powp a b) (TmP.lit 0)) = true) :
    (evalTmP env a) ^ (evalTmP env b).toNat = 0 :=
  checkP_sound env _ h
candidates.origin: ROUND 5 for refusal-symbolic-exponent, carrying the PASSED p7-parallel-tower-r4 verbatim and adding EXACTLY ONE further requirement the committed class measurement still names as unmet.  WHICH REQUIREMENT, and why r4 called itself last: tests/test_symbolic_exponent_class.py names the tower TWICE, at two granularities, and r4's origin note read only the narrower one.  The executable assertion test_the_reflect_slice_has_no_term_level_exponent enumerates five walkers (evalTm, evalTmN, substTm, evalTm_subst, evalTmN_subst) and r1..r4 met all five.  The SAME file's module docstring enumerates six -- `a new evalTm case, a new evalTmN case, a new substTm case, a new substTm_evalTm case, a new check/decDenote case` -- and the sixth, the check/decDenote case, is the one the prototype had no answer for at all: r4's tower is TERMS ONLY, so nothing over it was ever decided, checked, or proven sound, and `decidability INHERITED from decDenote` (PLAN_FRAGMENT s3.1 rule 3's third additive criterion) was an untested claim for powp.  This round supplies that layer: PdP (a parallel predicate inductive over TmP, four constructors -- two atoms and the two connectives whose recursion is what actually exercises inherited decidability), denoteP, the decDenoteP instance mirroring the committed decDenote (tools/FgReflect.lean:98-121) arm for arm, checkP mirroring check (:123), and checkP_sound mirroring check_sound (:127-129) -- of_decide_eq_true, the same one line.  The tooth that makes it about THIS row rather than about predicates in general is checkP_sound_powp: a `true` from the checker on an equation whose left side carries the new powp constructor IS a proof about the power itself, which is what the inheritance claim has to cash out to.  It is stated against TmP.lit 0 so the conclusion is a closed arithmetic fact rather than a tautology, and it is proven by checkP_sound alone, so no arm reasons about `^` specially -- powp reaches decDenoteP only through evalTmP, exactly as Tm.mul reaches decDenote through evalTm.  If this passes, the prototype answers BOTH enumerations the measurement carries and the row's authoring queue is complete; ADOPTING it into tools/FgReflect.lean stays an attended purchase decision under the ordinary bill discipline, never an unattended session's act.  Still a PARALLEL tower appended after the committed slice (the splice constraint: Tm and Pd cannot be extended from an append), still a PROPOSAL and never a slice edit.
